word_translation_en: to succeed; to turn out well
sentence_example: Es wird uns gelingen, das Projekt rechtzeitig abzuschließen.
sentence_example_translation_en: We will succeed in finishing the project on time.
sentence_synonym: Es wird uns glücken, das Projekt rechtzeitig abzuschließen.
typical_collocations: es gelingt jemandem; spielend gelingen; auf Anhieb gelingen; ein Versuch gelingt
usage_comments_en: 'gelingen' is an impersonal verb that always takes a dative object of the person (jemandem gelingt etwas). The logical subject in English becomes the dative object in German. It is more formal than the colloquial alternative 'klappen'.

sentence_example: Das Konzert war eine rundum gelungene Veranstaltung.
sentence_example_translation_en: The concert was an all-around successful event.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Концерт был во всех отношениях успешным мероприятием.
sentence_synonym: Das Konzert war eine rundum erfolgreiche Veranstaltung.
typical_collocations: eine gelungene Überraschung; ein gelungener Abend; ein gelungenes Werk; rundum gelungen
usage_comments_en: While 'gelungen' is the past participle of 'gelingen', it is very frequently used as an attributive and predicative adjective. It describes something that has turned out exceptionally well and brings positive satisfaction. Colloquially, it can also describe a person who is amusing or slightly peculiar ('ein gelungener Typ').
